text:
Maddy: Heads up team  BrightRiver POC is having flaky auth + burst throttles during the executive demo. Demo in 40m. They see 401s intermittently and 429 spikes when traffic hits ~18-22 TPS. Need hotfix and comms. @Ravi @Elena please triage.

Ravi: On it. 401s look auth-related; 429s are our per-customer limiter. Can we get a sample request/response + headers from their SDK logs?

Maddy: Sending via DM. Example:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-bb-demo" -d '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"test"}]}' -v
```
Response: HTTP/1.1 401
{"error":"invalid_api_key"}
Another request shows X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0 and a 429.

Diego: Customer uses transient session tokens minted by their auth-proxy. They upgraded proxy yesterday. Possible token rotation bug or JWKS fetch timeout.

Elena: Infra logs show our token-introspect service returning 502 for a few requests at 2026-12-09T21:10:05Z, followed by rate-limit hits. Snippet (sanitized):
```
2026-12-09T21:10:05Z req=rb-9a2 ip=3.120.45.67 path=/v1/chat status=401 err=\"invalid_api_key\" token=tok-sess-123
2026-12-09T21:10:06Z req=rb-9a3 ip=3.120.45.67 path=/v1/chat status=429 err=\"rate_limit_exceeded\" X-RateLimit-Remaining=0
```

Priya: From security POV, short-lived tokens + JWKS misses = common failure mode. Any evidence client failing to refresh tokens or clock skew?

Maddy: They confirmed proxy v2.1 rolled out at 08:30 PT. Their proxy logs show occasional 502 when talking to our introspect endpoint.

Ravi: Quick mitigation options: 1) give them a temporary server API key for the demo (simplest) OR 2) temporarily raise their rate-limit and add a 10s token grace window on token validation. Option 1 is lower infra risk.

Elena: I can bump their limit to 300 TPS for the POC on the Dedicated pool and enable a short-grace window in token validation for 15m. Applying now.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: changed customer=brightriver rate_limit=300 and token_validation.grace=15s by infra at 2026-12-09T21:12:14Z

Maddy: BrightRiver switched demo to server key for the next run. Will report back in 10m.

Ravi: Observing metrics  401s drop dramatically after server-key use. 429s drop too after bump, though we see a brief warm-up spike likely due to KV cache cold misses on model shards. I pushed a small cache-warming config for the model serving tier.

Diego: Noted: update POC runbook to require test sweep after auth-proxy upgrades and add a checklist item for token refresh test.

Sara: On pricing: I'll mark demo bursts as complimentary for this week and document in the SOW addendum. Sending one-pager to legal.

Priya: Security approves server-key use for the demo only. Conditions: key rotation within 12 hours and an audit entry in SECT-721 with justification.

Maddy: Customer reports the demo completed successfully. Thanks team. Follow-ups: add alert for JWKS/introspect failures, include proxy version in onboarding, and automate warm cache on demo start.

Elena: Filing INF-2102 to add JWKS/introspect alert and INF-2103 for automatic cache pre-warm routine.

Ravi: I'll create the incident timeline and link INF tickets + the SOW addendum. Closing swarm unless anyone objects. :thumbsup:

Diego: Good job. I'll send runbook PR and ping customer success to confirm post-demo key rotation.

Maddy: Closing thread. Will follow up in email and update the POC tracker. :lock:
